notes: Comprehensive collection of 100 Florida animal welfare organizations including municipal shelters, humane societies, SPCAs, breed-specific rescues, wildlife rehabilitation centers, horse rescues, farm sanctuaries, TNR programs, and spay/neuter clinics. Florida has one of the largest shelter systems in the US. Coverage spans all major metros including Jacksonville, Orlando, Tampa, Miami, Fort Lauderdale, West Palm Beach, and surrounding areas. Humane Society of Tampa Bay (founded 1912) is one of Florida's oldest corporations.
